items.title_en: S&P downgrades Oracle to BBB – only one notch above junk level
items.title_zh: S&P 将 Oracle 降级至 BBB：仅高于垃圾级一个档次
items.summary_en: S&P downgrades Oracle to BBB, signaling rising credit risk despite Oracle's AI and cloud ambitions. The move could raise borrowing costs and affect investor sentiment.
items.summary_zh: 标准普尔将 Oracle 降级至 BBB，仅比垃圾级高一个档次，表明市场对其财务和经营风险的担忧。降级可能推高公司融资成本，并影响投资者信心。

items.title_en: Measuring Input Latency on Linux: X11 vs. Wayland, VRR, and DXVK
items.title_zh: 在 Linux 上测量输入延迟：X11 与 Wayland、VRR 与 DXVK 的比较
items.summary_en: An empirical study measuring input latency on Linux across X11 and Wayland, with VRR and DXVK in the mix. It establishes a framework for end-to-end latency testing in gaming workloads and highlights how the choice of display server and graphics stack can shift responsiveness. The takeaway for developers is to prefer Wayland for lower latency in gaming scenarios and to be mindful of DXVK overhead depending on the workload.
items.summary_zh: 基于对 Linux 输入延迟的对比测量，覆盖 X11、Wayland、VRR 与 DXVK 的组合。研究建立了端到端延迟的测试框架，并揭示了显示服务器和显卡驱动栈的选择对响应速度的影响。结论是游戏场景下 Wayland 往往能带来更低的延迟，同时要关注 DXVK 路径的额外开销与 VRR 带来的抖动收益。

items.title_en: The Tower Keeps Rising
items.title_zh: 塔楼仍在不断升高
items.summary_en: Tech systems keep piling on layers and complexity as projects scale, increasing maintenance overhead and slowing developers.
items.summary_zh: 随着项目规模扩大，技术系统不断叠加层级与复杂性，导致维护成本上升、开发者体验受挫。

items.title_en: Are we offloading too much of our thinking to AI?
items.title_zh: 我们是不是把太多思考交给 AI？
items.summary_en: We're increasingly offloading thinking to AI, but overreliance risks dulling critical thinking, misframing problems, and eroding human agency. The piece calls for balancing automation with human judgment.
items.summary_zh: 我们越来越多地把思考交给 AI，文章认为过度依赖会削弱批判性思维、使问题界定偏离实际，并侵蚀个人主动性。应在自动化与人类判断之间保持平衡。

items.title_en: Codex starts encrypting sub-agent prompts
items.title_zh: Codex 开始对子代理提示进行加密
items.summary_en: OpenAI Codex now encrypts prompts used by sub-agents to protect sensitive instructions across agent calls. The change reduces prompt leakage and improves security for multi-agent workflows, though it may complicate debugging and require key management.
items.summary_zh: OpenAI Codex 现对子代理所使用的提示进行加密，以在代理调用之间保护敏感指令。此举降低了提示泄露风险，提升多代理工作流的安全性，但可能增加调试难度与密钥管理负担。

items.title_en: Bonsai 27B (1-bit LLM): The First 27B-Class Model to Run on a Phone
items.title_zh: Bonsai 27B（1 位量化 LLM）：首个在手机上运行的 27B 级模型
items.summary_en: A 27B-class LLM runs on a smartphone using 1-bit quantization, marking a milestone for on-device AI. The approach enables offline inference and privacy-preserving interactions, but trade-offs remain in accuracy and latency against cloud models.
items.summary_zh: 一个27B级的LLM通过1位量化在手机上运行，标志着边缘AI的一大里程碑。该方法实现离线推理和更高隐私，但在准确性和延迟方面仍需权衡，与云端模型相比存在差异。

items.title_en: How to stop Claude from saying load-bearing
items.title_zh: 如何让 Claude 不再说‘承重’
items.summary_en: Offers concrete prompt engineering and safety tricks to prevent Claude from making unsafe or overconfident 'load-bearing' claims, guiding users toward safer outputs.
items.summary_zh: 提供具体的提示工程和安全技巧，防止 Claude 发表不安全或过度自信的“承重”论断，帮助用户获得更安全的输出。

items.title_en: Show HN: Opening lines of famous literary works
items.title_zh: 公开展示：著名文学作品的开篇句
items.summary_en: A Show HN project collecting opening lines from famous books, offering quick access for language model prompts, literary analysis, and education. It also touches on public-domain boundaries and copyright considerations.
items.summary_zh: 一个展示著名文学作品开篇句的公开项目，方便用于语言模型基准、提示设计或文学学习。该项目引发对公共领域与版权边界的讨论，并展示可获取文本在实验中的价值。

items.title_en: Germany set to restrict its Freedom of Information Act
items.title_zh: 德国拟限制其信息自由法
items.summary_en: Germany plans tighter limits on FOIA requests, balancing transparency with privacy and security concerns, potentially curbing public access to government information.
items.summary_zh: 德国拟对信息自由法设定更严格的限度，在透明度、隐私和安全之间寻找平衡，或将限制公众获取政府信息的途径。

items.title_en: European "age verification" "app" forcing everyone to use Android or iOS
items.title_zh: 欧洲的年龄验证应用强制使用 Android 或 iOS
items.summary_en: European age-verification discussions reveal a regulatory push that effectively forces users onto mobile platforms, raising concerns about privacy, interoperability, and accessibility.
items.summary_zh: 关于欧洲年龄验证应用的讨论揭示了一个监管推动，实质上强制用户依赖 Android 或 iOS，带来隐私、互操作性与可访问性方面的担忧。

items.title_en: Japan develops a method to recover up to 90% of lithium from used EV batteries
items.title_zh: 日本开发可从废旧新能源汽车电池回收高达90%的锂
items.summary_en: Japan has demonstrated a process capable of recovering up to 90% of lithium from spent EV batteries, boosting recycling efficiency and extending battery supply resilience. The advance could lower material costs and lessen environmental impact by reducing mining and refining needs.
items.summary_zh: 日本展示了一种可从废旧电动车电池中回收锂高达90%的工艺，显著提升回收效率并加强电池材料保障。此举可能降低成本、减轻采矿与精炼带来的环境压力。

items.title_en: Proof of care in the age of AI
items.title_zh: AI 时代的关怀证明
items.summary_en: Explores how care concepts adapt in AI-enabled society, proposing 'proof of care' as a metric for AI systems to demonstrate alignment with human values and responsibilities.
items.summary_zh: 探讨 AI 时代对“关怀”概念的适应，提出“关怀证明”作为衡量 AI 系统是否与人类价值与责任对齐的指标。

items.title_en: Punch yourself in the face with reality
items.title_zh: 用现实狠狠打醒自己
items.summary_en: A blunt manifesto urging practitioners to confront practical constraints and real-world impact of AI projects, countering hype with concrete milestones and measurable results.
items.summary_zh: 直言不讳地呼吁从业者正视 AI 项目的现实约束与实际影响，用明确的里程碑和可衡量的成果抵制炒作。

items.title_en: Codex scraped the ICM website and discovered 2026 Fields Medal winner list
items.title_zh: Codex 抓取 ICM 网站，发现 2026 年菲尔兹奖得主名单
items.summary_en: Codex scraped public math pages and conference listings to surface the 2026 Fields Medal winners early, illustrating how AI reconnaissance can reveal ahead-of-time information.
items.summary_zh: Codex 抓取公开的数学资料与会议页面，提前暴露了 2026 年菲尔兹奖得主名单，凸显 AI 勘探对信息时效性的影响。

items.title_en: Agnes Callard’s theory of the uni-context
items.title_zh: 阿格尼斯·卡拉德的统一情境理论
items.summary_en: Philosopher Agnes Callard proposes a 'uni-context' approach, arguing that meaning hinges on a single, shared frame. This lens challenges pluralistic interpretations and invites reflection on how we compare normative arguments across cultures.
items.summary_zh: 哲学家阿格尼斯·卡拉德提出了“统一情境”观念，认为意义依赖于一个共同的框架。这一视角挑战了多元化解读，促使我们反思在跨文化讨论中如何比较规范性论点。

items.title_en: Beautiful Type Erasure with C++26 Reflection
items.title_zh: 用 C++26 反射实现优雅的类型擦除
items.summary_en: C++26 introduces reflection features that simplify type erasure, letting library authors write generic interfaces with less boilerplate and zero-cost abstractions. The piece demonstrates elegant patterns for erasing concrete types using reflection.
items.summary_zh: C++26 引入的反射特性简化了类型擦除，使库作者能够用更少的样板代码实现通用接口，且保持零代价抽象。文章演示了用反射实现类型擦除的优雅模式。

items.title_en: The git history command
items.title_zh: x86 是否准备好大显身手？
items.summary_en: The piece argues that the x86 ecosystem needs to adapt to rapidly evolving workloads, highlighting compiler and memory hierarchy considerations for modern AI and data-centric tasks. It examines tradeoffs and paths for x86 to stay competitive with newer architectures.
items.summary_zh: 本文评估 x86 架构在快速演进的 AI 与数据密集型工作负载中的竞争力，关注编译器、内存层次结构等方面的权衡与改进路径，探讨其在新兴架构面前的定位。

items.title_en: Show HN: I RL-trained an agent that trains models with RL (for –$1.3k)
items.title_zh: Show HN：我用 RL 训练了一个用 RL 训练模型的代理（花费约 1.3 千美元）
items.summary_en: A proof-of-concept agent trained with reinforcement learning uses RL to train other models, achieving a full loop on AI training at a modest budget.
items.summary_zh: 一个用强化学习训练、再用强化学习训练其他模型的代理，展示了以低成本完成整套 AI 训练循环的可行性。

items.title_en: The Future Worth Building Is Human
items.title_zh: 值得构建的未来是人类
items.summary_en: Advocates a human-centered tech future, stressing purpose, ethics, and governance as the true measures of value in innovation.
items.summary_zh: 倡导以人为本的科技未来，强调目的性、伦理与治理才是创新价值的真实衡量标准。

items.title_en: Australian energy retailers must provide three hours of free daytime electricity
items.title_zh: 澳大利亚能源零售商须提供三小时免费 daytime 用电
items.summary_en: Australian energy retailers are mandated to offer three hours of free daytime electricity, a policy designed to shift consumption to off-peak periods and improve grid stability. The article explains how it will work, who qualifies, and funding details.
items.summary_zh: 该政策要求能源零售商在白天提供三小时免费用电，旨在将用电转向非高峰时段、提升电网稳定性。文中解释了执行方式、覆盖范围及资金来源。

items.title_en: Former NOAA employees built Climate.us to preserve climate data and resources
items.title_zh: 前 NOAA 员工创建 Climate.us 以保存气候数据与资源
items.summary_en: A project by former NOAA staff to archive climate data and related resources, addressing data accessibility and preservation challenges as data grows and policies evolve.
items.summary_zh: 由前 NOAA 员工创建的 Climate.us 项目，旨在存档气候数据及相关资源，解决数据日益增长与政策变化带来的获取与长期保存挑战。

items.title_en: Indian scientists produce most detailed 3D atlas of the human brainstem
items.title_zh: 印度科学家制成最详细的人脑干三维图谱
items.summary_en: Researchers publish the most detailed 3D brainstem atlas to date, enabling finer neuroanatomical mapping and potentially improving diagnostics and neurosurgical planning.
items.summary_zh: 研究人员发布迄今最详细的人脑干三维图谱，未来可提升神经解剖映射精度、诊断与神经外科规划。

items.title_en: FDA authorized Zyn nicotine pouches without knowing what they were made of
items.title_zh: FDA 在不知道成分的情况下就批准 Zyn 尼古丁咀嚼包
items.summary_en: FDA approved Zyn nicotine pouches without full knowledge of their composition, stirring questions about microplastics exposure and long-term safety. The disclosure highlights regulatory gaps and potential public health risk.
items.summary_zh: 监管机构在未掌握全部成分信息的情况下批准 Zyn 尼古丁咀嚼包，引发对微塑料暴露与长期安全性的担忧。该事件凸显监管缺口及潜在的公共健康风险。

items.title_en: New York becomes the first state to impose a data center moratorium
items.title_zh: 纽约成为首个对数据中心实施暂停令的州
items.summary_en: New York votes to pause new data centers as authorities study energy demand and grid resilience, a possible pause on hyperscale expansion and a push for greener, more efficient designs.
items.summary_zh: 纽约通过暂停新数据中心来评估能源需求和电网韧性，可能会放缓超大规模扩张并推动更绿色、/更高效的设计。

items.title_en: Apple's new SpeechAnalyzer API, benchmarked against Whisper and its predecessor
items.title_zh: 苹果新 SpeechAnalyzer API 与 Whisper 对比基准
items.summary_en: Apple's new SpeechAnalyzer API is benchmarked against Whisper and Apple's own older speech API. The results highlight on-device performance, latency, and accuracy tradeoffs, offering insights into when to choose cloud vs. on-device processing for voice apps.
items.summary_zh: 苹果新推出的 SpeechAnalyzer API 经过与 Whisper 及前代 API 的对比基准测试，凸显了设备端与云端推理的权衡。评测聚焦准确率、延迟和噪声鲁棒性，为构建本地化语音应用提供实用参考。

items.title_en: Coding agents think ahead of time
items.title_zh: 编码代理的前瞻性思考
items.summary_en: A paper argues coding agents can plan ahead by simulating future states, improving reliability. The approach integrates forward-looking reasoning into automated coding workflows.
items.summary_zh: 论文提出编码代理通过模拟未来状态来进行前瞻性规划，从而提升可靠性。该方法将前瞻性推理融入自动化编码工作流。

items.title_en: Building and shipping Mac and iOS apps without opening Xcode
items.title_zh: 无需打开 Xcode 就能构建与发布 Mac 与 iOS 应用
items.summary_en: Describes a workflow to build and ship Mac and iOS apps without ever opening Xcode, relying on CLI tools and automation. It highlights how signing, packaging, and deployment can be automated in CI/CD, reducing GUI-focused work.
items.summary_zh: 介绍了一条无需打开 Xcode 就能构建和发布 Mac 与 iOS 应用的工作流，依赖命令行工具与自动化。强调在 CI/CD 中自动化签名、打包与部署，减少对 GUI 的依赖。

items.title_en: Alternative(s) to run CUDA on non-Nvidia hardware
items.title_zh: 在非 Nvidia 硬件上运行 CUDA 的替代方案
items.summary_en: Reviews projects aiming to provide CUDA-like acceleration on non-NVIDIA GPUs, examining trade-offs between performance, compatibility, and developer effort.
items.summary_zh: 评估在非 Nvidia GPU 上实现类似 CUDA 加速的方案，分析性能、兼容性与开发成本间的权衡。

items.title_en: OpenAI mandates hardware-backed passkeys for Trusted Access Cyber members
items.title_zh: OpenAI 要求 Trusted Access Cyber 成员使用硬件背书的通行密钥
items.summary_en: OpenAI requires hardware-backed passkeys for Trusted Access Cyber members, raising the bar for secure authentication and potentially influencing enterprise security practice.
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 要求 Trusted Access Cyber 成员使用硬件背书的通行密钥，提升认证安全标准，或影响企业安全实践。

items.title_en: The Agentic Loop: Three loops in a trench coat
items.title_zh: 代理性循环：三个环路合体
items.summary_en: Introduces the Agentic Loop, a model with three interacting feedback loops governing how AI agents decide, act, and learn, highlighting safety and governance implications.
items.summary_zh: 提出代理性循环模型，描述决策、行动与学习三个互相作用的反馈环路及其安全与治理挑战。

items.title_en: No Spanish reading crisis?
items.title_zh: 没有西班牙语阅读危机？
items.summary_en: Challenges the notion of a Spanish-reading decline by presenting data and policy implications, arguing that literacy trends are nuanced and policy should target concrete gaps rather than alarm.
items.summary_zh: 对“西班牙语阅读危机”的说法提出质疑，给出数据与政策含义，指出识字趋势较为复杂，应聚焦具体差距而非煽动性担忧。

items.title_en: Launch HN: Agnost AI (YC S26) – Extract user feedback from agent conversations
items.title_zh: Agnost AI（YC S26）—从代理对话中提取用户反馈
items.summary_en: Agnost AI offers tooling to extract structured user feedback from agent conversations, helping product teams quickly identify issues and improve agent behavior, speeding iteration and alignment.
items.summary_zh: Agnost AI 提供从代理对话中提取结构化用户反馈的工具，帮助产品团队更高效地迭代并改进代理表现，提升迭代效率。它将对话中的反馈转化为可操作的改进点。

items.title_en: The great digital fatigue: How digital burnout is changing social media use
items.title_zh: 数字疲惫：数字倦怠如何改变社媒使用
items.summary_en: Digital fatigue is reshaping how people use social media, pushing platforms toward shorter sessions, mental health considerations, and new notification designs.
items.summary_zh: 数字疲惫正在改变人们使用社交媒体的方式，推动平台采用更短的使用时段、关注心理健康并改进通知设计。

items.title_en: Just Let Me Write Digits
items.title_zh: 就让我写数字吧
items.summary_en: If you instead feed models with digits, simpler prompts can yield more reliable results; demonstrates digit-centric interfaces and error robustness.
items.summary_zh: 改用数字输入时，较简单的提示往往更可靠，展示了以数字为中心的接口设计与错误鲁棒性。

items.title_en: YouTrackDB is a general-use object-oriented graph database
items.title_zh: YouTrackDB：通用型面向对象图数据库
items.summary_en: YouTrackDB positions itself as a general-use object-oriented graph database, blending OO data modeling with graph traversal capabilities. It aims to offer a unified API for nodes and edges, appealing to developers who want both OOP ergonomics and rich graph queries.
items.summary_zh: YouTrackDB 将自己定位为通用型的面向对象图数据库，将面向对象的数据建模与图遍历能力结合，提供一个统一的节点/边操作 API。对同时追求 OOP 体验与丰富图查询的开发者而言，这类数据库能简化数据建模与关系表达。

items.title_en: Samsung Health app threatens data deletion if users opt out AI training
items.title_zh: 三星 Health 应用若用户不参与 AI 训练将删除其数据
items.summary_en: Samsung Health policy reportedly deletes user data if they opt out of AI training. The move raises concerns about user consent, data ownership, and the limits of opt-out choices in AI-enabled services.
items.summary_zh: 三星健康应用据称若用户不参与 AI 训练就删除其数据。这一政策引发对用户同意、数据所有权以及 AI 服务中隐私权边界的担忧。

items.title_en: Telegram's t.me domain has been suspended
items.title_zh: Telegram 的 t.me 短链域名已被暂停
items.summary_en: Telegram’s short-link domain t.me has been suspended, breaking many inbound and outbound redirects. The disruption highlights how external domain control can affect critical communication channels and the importance of redundancy.
items.summary_zh: Telegram 的 t.me 短链域名已被暂停，导致大量链接跳转失效。此举凸显外部域名控制对关键通信渠道的影响，以及建立冗余的重要性。

items.title_en: Tensor Is the Might
items.title_zh: 张量就是力量
items.summary_en: Argues that tensors underpin modern ML performance, shaping hardware, software, and algorithms; a reflection on how tensor-centric design drives efficiency and capability.
items.summary_zh: 强调张量在现代机器学习中的核心作用，影响硬件、软件与算法的设计，展示以张量为中心的设计如何推动效率与能力提升。

items.title_en: IBM Stock has worst day
items.title_zh: IBM 股价创历史最差日
items.summary_en: IBM shares endured a sharp decline, marking the worst one-day performance on record. The move reflects investor concerns about profits, AI strategy, or cloud growth.
items.summary_zh: IBM 股价经历历史上最差一天，股价大幅下挫。投资者担忧可能来自盈利、未来指引或对 AI 与云业务增长的预期。

items.title_en: Fundamentals of Wireless Communication (2005)
items.title_zh: 无线通信基础
items.summary_en: A concise, foundational guide to wireless communication theory, covering signal propagation, modulation, coding, and multi-user channels. It helps engineers and students reason about spectrum use, interference, and system design tradeoffs across modern wireless networks.
items.summary_zh: 这本基础教材系统讲解了无线通信的理论与工程要点，包括信号传播、调制、编码以及多用户信道等，帮助读者理解频谱利用、干扰与系统设计取舍。对从事5G/6G、物联网等领域的工程师和学生尤为有益。

items.title_en: Differentiable Fortran with LFortran and Enzyme
items.title_zh: 用 LFortran 与 Enzyme 实现可微分 Fortran
items.summary_en: Combining LFortran with Enzyme enables differentiable Fortran, bringing autodiff to legacy scientific code and easing integration with ML workloads.
items.summary_zh: 将 LFortran 与 Enzyme 结合，实现在 Fortran 中的可微分性，为遗留科学代码引入自动微分，并便于与 ML 工作负载整合。

items.title_en: An Englishwoman who sketched India before photography took hold
items.title_zh: 摄影普及前，一位英国女性绘制印度
items.summary_en: A historical portrait of a British woman who sketched scenes across India before photography took hold, preserving a visual record of places, people, and everyday life. Her drawings illuminate how pre-photography travelers documented distant lands and influenced later perceptions.
items.summary_zh: 讲述一位英国女性在摄影普及之前绘制印度风景与人物的历史记录，提供对当时地方与民俗的可视化记载。她的素描揭示了摄影前旅行者记录异域风貌的方式及对后世认知的影响。

items.title_en: Satellite Tracker – Live Map of Starlink and 30k Satellites
items.title_zh: 卫星追踪器——星链与3万颗卫星的实时地图
items.summary_en: A live map visualizes Starlink satellites alongside tens of thousands of others, offering a real-time view of orbital density and coverage. The tool highlights how mega-constellations and space debris could affect satellite operations and traffic management.
items.summary_zh: 实时地图将星链卫星与数万颗卫星呈现在同一画面，提供轨道密度与覆盖范围的即时视图。该工具凸显大型星座与航天垃圾对卫星运营和轨道交通管理的潜在影响。

items.title_en: The Economics of Recursive Self-Improvement [pdf]
items.title_zh: 递归自我改进的经济学
items.summary_en: This paper analyzes the economic dynamics of systems that recursively improve themselves, exploring incentives, resource constraints, and potential runaway growth. It discusses barriers to self-improvement, market feedback, and how governance and safety considerations shape investment in such capabilities.
items.summary_zh: 本文从激励、资源约束和潜在的滚雪球式增长等角度，探讨递归自我改进系统的经济学，并分析实现路径、市场反馈以及治理与安全对相关投资的影响。

items.title_en: Actegories
items.title_zh: Actegories：行动范畴
items.summary_en: Actegories explain how categories act on other categories via functors, a concept linking category theory to higher algebra and functional programming.
items.summary_zh: Actegories 讲解范畴如何通过函子作用于其他范畴，将范畴论与高等代数、函数式编程连接起来。

items.title_en: The infinite scroll may become endangered if controversial Calif. law passes
items.title_zh: 若加州通过有争议的法律，无限滚动将岌岌可危
items.summary_en: A California law proposal could constrain infinite scrolling, potentially impacting content surfacing and monetization on social platforms. The piece analyzes UX, policy and business-model implications.
items.summary_zh: 加州拟议的法规可能限制无限滚动，或影响社媒平台的内容呈现与盈利模式。文章分析了对用户体验、政策与商业模式的潜在影响。

items.title_en: Demis Hassabis has a plan to harness AI safely
items.title_zh: Demis Hassabis 有一个安全利用 AI 的计划
items.summary_en: Hassabis outlines a safety-centric AI roadmap, emphasizing rigorous safety research, governance, and international cooperation to steer AI development toward beneficial, controllable outcomes.
items.summary_zh: 哈萨比斯勾勒出以安全为核心的 AI 路线图，强调加强安全研究、治理与国际合作，推动 AI 发展向有益且可控的方向前进。

items.title_en: What will be left for us to work on?
items.title_zh: 我们还能从事哪些工作？
items.summary_en: As automation and AI advance, the piece questions what meaningful human work will remain and how to re-skill. It discusses shifts in labor markets, creativity, care work, and the role of policy.
items.summary_zh: 随着自动化和人工智能的发展，探讨未来人类可以从事的有意义工作，以及如何通过再培训应对劳动力市场的变动。关注创造性、关怀类工作和政策作用。

items.title_en: The Death of the Creator Middle Class
items.title_zh: 创作者中产阶级的死亡
items.summary_en: The creator middle class is under pressure from platform economics and AI-enabled competition, threatening sustainable income for independent creators. The piece calls for new revenue models and stronger protections.
items.summary_zh: 平台经济和 AI 竞争正在侵蚀独立创作者的收入，使其逐渐从中产阶级消失。文章呼吁探索新的收入模式并加强保护。

items.title_en: Is x86 ready to ACE it?
items.title_zh: x86 是否准备好大显身手？
items.summary_en: The piece evaluates whether x86 architecture is keeping pace with AI workloads and advanced accelerators, considering performance, memory bandwidth, and compiler ecosystem. It discusses potential pathways for x86 to stay relevant in AI era.
items.summary_zh: 文章评估 x86 架构是否能跟上 AI 工作负载与高级加速器的需求，涉及性能、内存带宽和编译器生态等因素，并探讨 x86 在 AI 时代保持相关性的可能路径。

items.title_en: Our Amish Language
items.title_zh: 我们的阿米什语言
items.summary_en: Explores the Amish language (Pennsylvania Dutch) within its cultural and historical context, touching on linguistic features, literacy, and how language use shapes community life in Amish contexts.
items.summary_zh: 本文从文化与历史语境出发，探讨阿米什语言（宾州荷兰语）的语言特征、读写传统，以及语言在阿米什社区中的日常生活与交流中的作用。

items.title_en: MorphoHDL: A minimalistic language for growing circuits
items.title_zh: MorphoHDL：一种用于生长电路的极简语言
items.summary_en: MorphoHDL introduces a minimalistic hardware description language aimed at modular, evolvable circuit design, enabling rapid experimentation with circuit morphology and growth. It emphasizes simplicity and composability for hardware innovation.
items.summary_zh: MorphoHDL 引入一种极简硬件描述语言，面向模块化、可进化的电路设计，支持快速试验电路形态与成长。强调简洁性与可组合性以推动硬件创新。

items.title_en: U of Chicago law school bans laptops from classes amid AI backlash
items.title_zh: 芝加哥大学法学院在 AI 反弹中禁用笔记本电脑
items.summary_en: The law school bans laptops during class as AI disrupts traditional teaching, sparking debate about access, equity, and pedagogy in the AI era.
items.summary_zh: 法学院在 AI 时代的冲击下禁止课上使用笔记本，引发关于机会平等、教学方式与获取可能性的讨论。

items.title_en: Show HN: Rejourney – Open-source revenue leak prediction for web and mobile apps
items.title_zh: Show HN：Rejourney——开源的网页与移动应用收入流失预测
items.summary_en: Rejourney is an open-source tool that predicts revenue leakage across web and mobile apps, helping teams spot churn risks and optimize monetization.
items.summary_zh: Rejourney 是一个开源工具，用于预测网页与移动应用中的收入流失，帮助团队发现流失风险并优化盈利。

items.title_en: Backtrack-Free Cursive
items.title_zh: 无回溯的连笔书写
items.summary_en: Explores a backtrack-free approach to cursive, likely within handwriting, typography, or algorithmic generation, aiming for smoother, more efficient output.
items.summary_zh: 探讨一种无回溯的连笔书写方法，可能涉及书写、排版或算法生成，旨在实现更顺滑、效率更高的连笔输出。

items.title_en: Linux 0.11 rewritten in idiomatic Rust, boots in QEMU
items.title_zh: Linux 0.11 用地道 Rust 重写并在 QEMU 启动
items.summary_en: An enthusiast rebuilt the Linux 0.11 kernel in idiomatic Rust and got it to boot in QEMU. The project demonstrates Rust’s viability for low-level systems work and serves as an educational bridge from classic kernels to modern tooling. It spotlights both the enduring complexity of OS internals and the expressive power of Rust abstractions.
items.summary_zh: 有人用地道的 Rust 重写 Linux 0.11，并在 QEMU 中成功启动。该项目展示了 Rust 在底层系统编程中的可行性，并为将经典内核迁移到现代工具链提供了学习路径。它揭示了操作系统内部的复杂性，以及 Rust 抽象能力的强大。

items.title_en: Nokia’s years of mobile-phone supremacy ended in an afternoon
items.title_zh: 诺基亚的移动电话霸权在一个下午被终结
items.summary_en: A retrospective on how Nokia lost its mobile leadership in a single afternoon as smartphones toppled feature phones, highlighting the speed of platform shifts.
items.summary_zh: 回顾诺基亚如何在一个下午失去移动领域的领先地位，智能手机取代功能机，凸显平台转换的速度。

items.title_en: Linux on the Sega 32X. Who needs hardware synchronization primitives anyway?
items.title_zh: 在世嘉 32X 上运行 Linux：谁还需要硬件同步原语？
items.summary_en: Running Linux on a Sega 32X demonstrates how far hobbyist OS ports can go on constrained hardware. The write-up explains software-based synchronization tricks used in place of hardware primitives.
items.summary_zh: 展示在世嘉 32X 这类受限硬件上运行 Linux 的可行性，体现业余端移植的边界。文中说明了用软件实现的同步技巧来替代硬件原语。

items.title_en: Success may not matter if you aren't doing what you love
items.title_zh: 如果你不做你热爱之事，成功或许并不重要
items.summary_en: A founder-focused reflection arguing that personal fulfillment and intrinsic motivation trump external success metrics. It advocates pursuing passions and aligning work with values to sustain long-term effort.
items.summary_zh: 这是一则面向创业者的人生反思，认为个人成就感与内在动机胜过外部成功指标，倡导追随热情、与价值观保持一致的工作，以支撑长期投入。

items.title_en: Show HN: YouTube Guitar Tab Parser
items.title_zh: Show HN：YouTube 吉他谱解析器
items.summary_en: An open-source YouTube guitar tab parser that extracts and structures guitar tablature from video content. It showcases how media content can be transformed into reusable, machine-readable data for musicians and educators.
items.summary_zh: 这是一个开源的 YouTube 吉他谱解析器，能够从视频中提取并结构化吉他谱数据。它演示了如何把多媒体内容转化为可重复使用、机器可读的数据，便于音乐家和教育者使用。

items.title_en: OpenAI's Ad Business Is on Pace to Miss Its Own Forecast by 90%, Analyst Says
items.title_zh: 分析师称 OpenAI 广告业务将比自家预测晚 90%
items.summary_en: An analyst says OpenAI’s ad business is on track to miss its own forecast by about 90%, signaling slower monetization or over-optimistic projections. The remark highlights how AI-related ad revenue expectations can diverge from reality and affect investor sentiment.
items.summary_zh: 分析师表示 OpenAI 的广告业务可能比自家预测落后约 90%，反映广告收入预期的保守性与现实之间的差距，以及对投资者情绪的潜在影响。

items.title_en: Show HN: I implemented a neural network in SQL
items.title_zh: Show HN：我在 SQL 中实现了神经网络
items.summary_en: I implemented a neural network in SQL, including a MNIST demo, illustrating how far computation can be pushed inside relational queries. The project invites readers to rethink the boundaries between databases and machine learning workloads.
items.summary_zh: 在 SQL 中实现了神经网络的尝试，包含一个 MNIST 演示，展示了把计算推向关系型查询的边界。此例促使人们思考数据库与机器学习工作负载之间的潜在结合。

items.title_en: Show HN: DOM-docx – HTML to native, editable Word docs (MIT)
items.title_zh: Show HN: DOM-docx — 将 HTML 转换为本地可编辑的 Word 文档（MIT 许可）
items.summary_en: DOM-docx is a Show HN project that converts HTML into native, editable Word documents under MIT license. It enables programmatic document generation with preserved styling, useful for automating content pipelines.
items.summary_zh: Show HN 项目 DOM-docx 将 HTML 转换为可本地编辑的 Word 文档，MIT 许可。该工具有助于用自动化方式保留样式并产出可编辑文档，适合构建内容流水线。

items.title_en: Benchmarking 15 “E-Waste” GPUs with Modern Workloads
items.title_zh: 用现代工作负载对 15 枚“E-Waste”GPU 进行基准测试
items.summary_en: Benchmarking 15 'E-Waste' GPUs with Modern Workloads tests legacy Tesla GPUs on current AI and compute tasks. The results reveal which older GPUs still offer value and where power-hungry hardware no longer makes sense.
items.summary_zh: 对 15 张被称为 'E-Waste' 的旧 GPU，在现代工作负载下进行基准测试，揭示哪些老设备仍具性价比、以及功耗与性能的权衡。

items.title_en: What did SFFA vs. Harvard reveal about admissions?
items.title_zh: SFFA 与哈佛案揭示了关于招生的什么
items.summary_en: The case highlights how courts use data-driven analyses to scrutinize admissions policies, with implications for diversity, holistic review, and legal standards.
items.summary_zh: 该案凸显法院如何利用数据分析审查招生政策，对多样性、综合考量及法律标准产生深远影响。

items.title_en: Ask HN: What Are You Working On? (July 2026)
items.title_zh: Ask HN：你在忙些什么？（2026 年 7 月）
items.summary_en: A community prompt inviting builders and researchers to share current projects, challenges, and progress. The thread often surfaces early-stage ideas, solo ventures, and collaboration opportunities across software and hardware domains, offering inspiration and networking value.
items.summary_zh: 这是一个社区征集贴，邀请开发者和研究者分享当前在做的项目、遇到的挑战与进展。此类贴子常揭示早期创意、个人项目，并提供跨领域的协作机会，具有启发性和社交价值。

items.title_en: TFTP Honey Pot Results
items.title_zh: TFTP 蜜罐结果
items.summary_en: A TFTP honeypot study reveals attacker behaviors and common exploitation patterns against TFTP services. Findings emphasize misconfigurations to watch and the need for better monitoring of legacy protocols.
items.summary_zh: 对 TFTP 蜜罐的研究揭示了攻击者的行为模式与常见利用方式。研究强调对旧式协议的错误配置和监控需求，以及加强对这类协议的防护。

items.title_en: Show HN: Jacquard, a programming language for AI-written, human-reviewed code
items.title_zh: Show HN：Jacquard，一种用于 AI 生成、人工审核代码的编程语言
items.summary_en: Jacquard proposes a programming language designed for AI-generated code that is nonetheless reviewed by humans. It explores tooling for traceability, reproducibility, and safe AI-assisted software development.
items.summary_zh: Jacquard 设计了一种用于 AI 生成、由人类审核代码的编程语言，强调可追溯性与可审查性。它探索了在 AI 辅助编程中实现更安全、可控的软件开发工具。

items.title_en: A Study of Microsoft's Early 2026 Rollout of Claude Code and GitHub Copilot CLI
items.title_zh: 微软对 Claude Code 与 GitHub Copilot CLI 在 2026 年初的早期推广研究
items.summary_en: Analyzes early rollout of Claude Code and Copilot CLI within Microsoft ecosystems, focusing on adoption, developer productivity, bug rates, and integration with tooling. Highlights how enterprise pilots shape AI-assisted development.
items.summary_zh: 分析 Claude Code 与 Copilot CLI 在微软生态中的早期推广，关注采用率、开发者生产力、缺陷率及与现有工具链的集成，揭示企业试点如何塑造 AI 辅助开发的前景。

items.title_en: Your 'app' could have been a webpage (so I fixed it for you)
items.title_zh: 你的“应用”其实可以是网页版本——我把它改成网页了
items.summary_en: A practical take on web vs native apps: many projects can be delivered as a robust webpage, reducing maintenance and improving accessibility. The post shows concrete steps to flatten typical app functionality into a responsive web UI.
items.summary_zh: 谈及网页与原生应用的现实取舍：很多项目其实可以用强大的网页版本来实现，降低维护成本并提升可访问性。文中给出将常见应用功能转换成响应式网页界面的具体做法。

items.title_en: A metallurgist's doubts about self-replicating probes
items.title_zh: 一位冶金学家的对自我复制探针的疑虑
items.summary_en: A metallurgist critiques the feasibility of self-replicating probes, stressing material science and engineering constraints that challenge the idea of nanoscopic 'von Neumann probes'.
items.summary_zh: 一位冶金学家对自我复制探针的可行性提出质疑，强调材料科学与工程约束对“冯·诺依曼探针”概念的挑战。

items.title_en: Building Food Metadata with LLM Juries
items.title_zh: 用大模型陪审团构建食品元数据
items.summary_en: DoorDash's post describes building food metadata with LLM juries, combining multiple models and context optimization to improve accuracy for multimodal food data. It demonstrates how ensemble prompts can reduce hallucinations in metadata generation.
items.summary_zh: 文章讲述如何通过大模型陪审团构建食品元数据，结合多模型与上下文优化提升多模态食品数据的准确性，并展示如何通过模型集成来降低信息偏差。

items.title_en: Show HN: Sx 2.0 – Share AI skills with your team through a Dropbox folder
items.title_zh: Show HN：Sx 2.0——通过 Dropbox 文件夹与团队分享 AI 技能
items.summary_en: Sx 2.0 enables teams to share AI skills by turning a Dropbox folder into a portable skill server, enabling quick distribution and reuse of prompts, tools, or configurations across a team.
items.summary_zh: Sx 2.0 通过将 Dropbox 文件夹变成一个可移植的技能服务器，让团队快速分发与复用 AI 提示、工具或配置。

items.title_en: Show HN: Sigwire – a live TUI switchboard for every signal on your Linux box
items.title_zh: Show HN：Sigwire——一款在 Linux 上实时显示所有信号的 TUI 切换板
items.summary_en: Sigwire is a live TUI tool that provides a real-time switchboard for all signals on your Linux box, enabling interactive monitoring and quick debugging from the terminal.
items.summary_zh: Sigwire 是一款实时 TUI 工具，提供 Linux 系统中所有信号的实时切换板，便于在终端进行交互式监控和快速调试。

items.title_en: The AI Whale Fall and Open Source
items.title_zh: AI 鲸落与开源生态
items.summary_en: The piece uses the whale fall analogy to discuss the AI/open-source ecosystem, suggesting that large AI projects leave behind infrastructure, code, and opportunities that sustain and energize the OSS community over time.
items.summary_zh: 文章以“鲸落”比喻 AI 与开源生态，论述大型 AI 项目在生态中遗留的基础设施、代码与机会，如何持续推动开源社区的发展。

items.title_en: Show HN: Hackney – Compare Uber, Lyft, Waymo, and Robotaxi Prices
items.title_zh: Show HN: Hackney – 比较 Uber、Lyft、Waymo 与 Robotaxi 的价格
items.summary_en: Hackney provides price comparison across ride-hailing and autonomous taxi services, helping users understand price dynamics and utilization of different transport options. Could influence consumer choices and market transparency.
items.summary_zh: Hackney 提供 Uber、Lyft、Waymo 与 Robotaxi 的定价比较，帮助用户理解不同出行选项的价格动态与利用情况，或推动消费者决策与市场透明度。

items.title_en: Show HN: Juggler – an open-source GUI coding agent, by the creator of JUCE
items.title_zh: Show HN：Juggler——开源 GUI 编码代理，由 JUCE 创作者开发
items.summary_en: Juggler is an open-source GUI coding agent built by the JUCE creator, aimed at generating UI code and components automatically. It signals progress toward autonomous GUI tooling that can accelerate interface development.
items.summary_zh: Juggler 是由 JUCE 创作者开发的开源 GUI 编码代理，旨在自动生成界面代码与组件。它标志着向自动化 GUI 工具迈进的进展，可能加速界面开发。

items.title_en: How the FSF sysadmins block botnets with reaction
items.title_zh: FSF 系统管理员如何用反应阻断僵尸网络
items.summary_en: FSF details reaction-based techniques to block botnets within the free-software ecosystem, combining monitoring, rapid response, and community-driven actions.
items.summary_zh: FSF 介绍了一套以“反应”为核心的阻断僵尸网络的方法，结合监控、快速响应与社区协作。

items.title_en: We need a PIT Crew for news
items.title_zh: 我们需要新闻的 PIT 团队
items.summary_en: Calls for a proactive news operation with rapid, iterative fixes, testing, and incident response akin to a pit crew to keep information accurate and up-to-date.
items.summary_zh: 呼吁组建一支高效的新闻运维团队，进行快速迭代修复、测试与事件响应，确保信息准确及时更新。

items.title_en: GhostLock, a stack-UAF that has existed in all Linux distributions for 15 years
items.title_zh: GhostLock：已在所有 Linux 发行版中存在 15 年的栈上使用后释放漏洞
items.summary_en: GhostLock is a stack-use-after-free vulnerability that has persisted across every Linux distribution for 15 years. Its ubiquity makes patching difficult and raises questions about how many systems remain unpatched, underscoring the need for systemic mitigations and kernel-level hardening.
items.summary_zh: GhostLock 是一个栈上使用后释放漏洞，已在所有 Linux 发行版中存在长达 15 年。问题的广泛性使修补工作复杂且难以全面覆盖，凸显对内核层面对策和系统级强化的迫切需求。

items.title_en: How to build a circular LCD clock
items.title_zh: 如何制作圆形 LCD 时钟
items.summary_en: This circular LCD clock guide demonstrates how to design and assemble a round clock using a microcontroller and a ring display. It covers layout decisions, wiring, and firmware considerations to bring a circular timepiece to life.
items.summary_zh: 本指南展示了如何用微控制器和环形显示屏搭建圆形 LCD 时钟，涵盖布局、连线与固件设计要点，帮助读者实现圆形时间显示。

items.title_en: Show HN: MemStitch – Zero-copy context bridging for vLLM (25x TTFT speedup)
items.title_zh: Show HN：MemStitch——面向 vLLM 的零拷贝上下文桥接（TTFT 提速 25x）
items.summary_en: MemStitch introduces zero-copy context bridging for vLLM, dramatically reducing memory movement and delivering about a 25x speedup on TTFT benchmarks. This approach can significantly improve latency and throughput for serving large language models.
items.summary_zh: MemStitch 为 vLLM 引入零拷贝上下文桥接，显著减少内存拷贝，TTFT 基准约提升 25x。该方法 could 大幅提升大模型服务的延迟和吞吐。

items.title_en: Why is LinkedIn enumerating my browser extensions?
items.title_zh: LinkedIn 为什么要枚举我的浏览器扩展？
items.summary_en: The post investigates privacy and security concerns around LinkedIn allegedly enumerating installed browser extensions. It highlights potential fingerprinting risks and steps readers can take to mitigate exposure.
items.summary_zh: 文章探讨 LinkedIn 似乎在枚举已安装的浏览器扩展所带来的隐私与安全风险，指出可能的指纹识别风险，并给出减轻暴露的做法。

items.title_en: Ancient Roman Board Game
items.title_zh: 古罗马桌游
items.summary_en: Ancient Roman Board Game presents a documented Roman board game with playable rules and online recreation. It offers a peek into ancient leisure culture and strategic play.
items.summary_zh: 展示一款被记录的古罗马棋盘游戏及其可玩规则与在线重现，揭示古代休闲生活与策略游戏的一角。

items.title_en: A tiny cell that broke a big rule of biology
items.title_zh: A tiny cell that broke a big rule of biology
items.summary_en: A minuscule cell challenges a fundamental rule of the nitrogen cycle, hinting at alternative metabolic pathways and microbial processes. The finding could influence fertilizer efficiency, bioprocessing, and our understanding of microbial nitrogen transformations.
items.summary_zh: 研究发现一种微小细胞挑战了氮循环中的基本规律，暴露出可能的替代代谢路径。此发现或影响肥料效率、生物工艺及对微生物氮转化过程的理解。

items.title_en: World-First 'Super Alloy' Could Transform the Way Metals Are Made
items.title_zh: 全球首个‘超合金’或将改变金属制造方式
items.summary_en: A breakthrough in metallurgical materials—a 'super alloy' with exceptional strength and heat resistance—promises to transform metal production and component performance. If scalable, it could cut energy use and enable longer-lasting components in aerospace, power, and manufacturing.
items.summary_zh: 一种具有卓越强度与耐热性的“超合金”实现材料科学的突破，可能改变金属生产与部件性能的格局。若实现规模化，将降低能源消耗，推动航空、能源与制造等领域的耐用部件应用。

items.title_en: The 'absolute magic' of Morse code that still connects people globally
items.title_zh: 摩尔斯电码的全球连接力仍在
items.summary_en: The piece celebrates Morse code as a resilient, 'magical' means of global communication that persists despite modern networks. It highlights its enduring relevance in emergencies, remote work, and hobbyist communities.
items.summary_zh: 文章讲述摩尔斯电码作为一种“绝对魔力”的全球通讯方式，尽管现代网络兴盛，它在紧急情况、偏远地区与爱好者社区中仍然发挥作用。

items.title_en: Notable Knot Index (2016)
items.title_zh: 著名结指数（2016）
items.summary_en: A curated index of notable knots from 2016, offering quick references for knot theory enthusiasts and topology researchers.
items.summary_zh: 整理了 2016 年的著名结，供结理论爱好者和拓扑学研究者快速参考。

items.summary_en: N+1 examines the idea of adding one more element to a system and the implications of that marginal change.
items.summary_zh: N+1 探讨在系统中再增加一个元素的想法及其边际变化带来的影响。

items.title_en: Paxos Made Simple (2001)[pdf]
items.title_zh: Paxos 简明论点（2001）
items.summary_en: Lamport's Paxos presented a concise, practical formulation of a distributed consensus algorithm; the paper remains foundational for building reliable fault-tolerant systems.
items.summary_zh: Lamport 的 Paxos 以简洁、务实的方式给出了分布式一致性算法的核心思想，至今是构建容错系统的基础性文献。

items.title_en: Writing a bindless GPU abstraction layer
items.title_zh: 编写无绑定的 GPU 抽象层
items.summary_en: It covers architectural trade-offs, potential patterns, and considerations for performance and portability.
items.summary_zh: 文章探讨如何设计一种无需显式绑定资源的 GPU 抽象层，以提升对现代显卡的可伸缩性。介绍了架构权衡、可能的实现模式，以及性能与可移植性的注意事项。

items.title_en: The zero-cost fallacy: open-source software in the agentic era
items.title_zh: 零成本谬误：代理时代的开源软件
items.summary_en: In an era of agentic AI, open-source software is no longer cost-free. Sustainable funding, governance, and security mechanisms are increasingly necessary as autonomous agents rely on open ecosystems. This implies a shift in how companies and communities sustain open-source projects.
items.summary_zh: 在代理时代，开源软件已不再是零成本。随着自治代理对开放生态的依赖增加，需要可持续的资金、治理和安全机制，并推动新的开源资助与治理模型。

items.title_en: The largest available Minecraft world, totalling 15 TB
items.title_zh: 现有最大的 Minecraft 世界：总容量达 15 TB
items.summary_en: The largest available Minecraft world spans 15 TB, pushing storage, streaming, and mod ecosystems to their limits. Such massive worlds stress hosting infrastructure, data integrity, and distribution challenges.
items.summary_zh: 总容量达 15 TB 的最大 Minecraft 世界展示了玩家社区在像素世界规模化方面的极限，考验存储、流式传输和模组生态系统的能力，也带来托管、数据一致性与分发的挑战。

items.title_en: Show HN: RandoFont – A browser for Google Fonts
items.title_zh: Show HN: RandoFont – 一个用于浏览 Google 字体的浏览器
items.summary_en: RandoFont offers a browser-based tool to explore and sample Google Fonts, facilitating quick font discovery and creative prototyping. Useful for designers and frontend developers seeking inspiration.
items.summary_zh: RandoFont 提供一个基于浏览器的工具，用于浏览和采样 Google 字体，便于快速发现灵感并进行前端原型设计。

items.title_en: Superoptimizer – A Look at the Smallest Program
items.title_zh: 超级优化器：最小程序的研究
items.summary_en: Superoptimizer explores the smallest possible program that still accomplishes a task, challenging assumptions about compiler optimization and program synthesis. It surveys the limits of program compression and has implications for verification and teaching about compilers.
items.summary_zh: 超级优化器研究在完成任务的前提下可达到的最小程序规模，挑战了对编译器优化与程序综合的直觉。它通过寻找最小指令序列来实现正确性，影响我们对优化、验证与编译教育的理解。

items.title_en: The Difference Between Watercolor and Gouache Paints
items.title_zh: 水彩与 gouache 的区别
items.summary_en: Explains the key differences between watercolor and gouache—opacity, layering, and re-wettability—plus practical use cases for each medium and tips for mastering their distinct behaviors.
items.summary_zh: 介绍水彩与 gouache 的核心区别：不透明度、分层与可重新上色性，并给出各自的使用场景与掌握要点。

items.title_en: The Origins of Heikki's Garden of Flowers
items.title_zh: Heikki 的 Garden of Flowers 起源
items.summary_en: A reflective piece tracing the origins of Heikki's Garden of Flowers, offering insights into the creative or technical influences shaping the project. It reads like a personal narrative about inspiration and growth.
items.summary_zh: 这是一篇追溯 Heikki 的花园之花起源的随笔，揭示了创作项目的灵感源泉与演变过程，提供个人成长的洞见。

items.title_en: Jektex 0.2.0 – A Jekyll plugin for LaTeX rendering is now ~10x faster
items.title_zh: Jektex 0.2.0：Jekyll 的 LaTeX 渲染插件提速约十倍
items.summary_en: Jektex 0.2.0 releases bring about a roughly 10x faster LaTeX rendering for Jekyll, likely via caching or a more efficient rendering pipeline. This milestone reduces build times for math-heavy sites with minimal API changes.
items.summary_zh: Jektex 0.2.0 版本让 Jekyll 的 LaTeX 渲染速度提升约 10 倍，通常通过缓存或更高效的渲染流程实现。对于包含大量公式的静态站点，构建时间将显著缩短且 API 变动很小。

items.title_en: Two Case Studies of NaN
items.title_zh: NaN 的两个案例研究
items.summary_en: The piece presents two practical scenarios illustrating NaN handling in computing, highlighting where NaN propagation and comparison rules bite in real code. It emphasizes robust NaN handling and cross-language pitfalls in data pipelines.
items.summary_zh: 本文通过两个实际场景展示 NaN 在计算中的处理方式，揭示在真实代码中 NaN 的传播和比较规则可能带来的坑。强调在数据管道中对 NaN 的鲁棒处理及跨语言的潜在误用。

items.title_en: Zero Knowledge Tolstoyan Art
items.title_zh: 零知识托尔斯泰风格艺术
items.summary_en: Examines applying zero-knowledge concepts to Tolstoyan art, exploring how cryptographic proofs could certify certain artistic properties without revealing underlying generation parameters. It sits at the intersection of cryptography and generative art.
items.summary_zh: 探讨将零知识原理应用于托尔斯泰风格的艺术创作，研究如何在不暴露生成参数的情况下证明某些艺术属性。将密码学与生成式艺术结合起来思考。
